item.title: Nakadashi Oyako ~Manamusume ni Ippai Sosoide Hoshii noo~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Hanimaru, Amenonuboko Co., Ltd.
  • 発売日: 2008-10-10
  • スコア: なし (3 人評価)
  • 日本語名: なかだし娘妹 愛娘にいっぱい注いでほしいのぉ
  • 英語名: Nakadashi Oyako Manamusume ni Ippai Sosoide Hoshii noo

あらすじ

A middle-aged teacher and widower named Hanyuu Akira has a relationship with his stepdaughter Hanyuu Ayuka, and decides to stay with her despite opposition from society. When his colleague and sister-in-law Sakaki Mina suspects the relationship, he sleeps with her to protect Ayuka. Later, when Ayuka is hospitalized, Mina moves into Akira’s house and begins a relentless pursuit of him.
